pages.title: Parasite from Leaves
pages.text: Breaking poop leaves has a chance to drop roundworms.$(br2)Roundworms are the ingredient used to roast string.

pages.title: Plantable
pages.text: Roundworms can be planted and grow into upward-climbing roundworm vines.$(br2)The vines also deal a small amount of damage to creatures that touch them.

pages.title: Seeds and Drops
pages.text: Use bone meal on roundworm vines to make them bear seeds.$(br2)Harvesting or breaking seeded vines drops 1-3 roundworms and randomly drops one of the following:$(li)Pumpkin Seeds$(li)Melon Seeds$(li)Frogspawn$(li)Beetroot Seeds
